title: Measure motion in the dividing fed-vortex regime: per-cycle travel of dividing vortices, and how much of it happens while paired with an opposite-sign partner (a self-propelled dipole)
summary: Analysis of the fed-vortex claim's packs (seeds 0-2): for each vortex born by a split that divides again, net travel in sqrt(area) and long axes, and the fraction of its life spent with an opposite-sign vortex within 2.5 sqrt(area).
